_doc: Keys and value types of the Claude Code SubagentStart hook payload recorded in one real run (plugin shoal
3.3.0, probe hook, 2026-10-12); values are synthetic.  session_id equals the main session's id; agent_id and
agent_type describe the NEW subagent (agent_type carries the plugin prefix, e.g. `shoal:executor`; a global
install shows the bare name).  Not measured: whether a role that fails to start still emits the event, and
whether prompt_id equals the id the guard sees on the main session's events for the same turn.
tests/test_shoal_guard.py feeds payloads built from this shape to adapt_claude.
